chapter: Jelly Roll Morton and Tempo Music
title: Tempo Music Publishing, Clarence Williams and sales of the songs
summary: They discuss the company name, using Clarence Williams as agent, print runs, sales of 300 to 500, and bands borrowing the music.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
